title: hydrangea serrata f. pubescens
intro: Hydrangea serrata f. pubescens, commonly known as Mountain Hydrangea, is a type of flowering plant native to the mountainous regions of East Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and soothing digestive issues due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Hydrangea include being an anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic agent, making it useful for treating conditions such as arthritis and menstrual cramps. The bioactive constituents of Hydrangea serrata f. pubescens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
